import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
]

# Columns expected in the target schema and their types for reference
target_columns = [
    'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
    'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
    'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
]

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the CSV index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files[0], index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files[1], index_col=0)

# Both source tables have the exact same schema as the target schema.
# According to Hint 2 and Hint 4, since schemas are identical, UNION (concat) is the preferred operation.

# Concatenate the two dataframes vertically (union)
df_concat = pd.concat([df0, df1], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
df_concat = df_concat[target_columns]

# Data type enforcement and conversions to match target schema:

# tripduration: integer
df_concat['tripduration'] = pd.to_numeric(df_concat['tripduration'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# starttime, stoptime: string (keep as is, but ensure no NaN)
df_concat['starttime'] = df_concat['starttime'].astype(str)
df_concat['stoptime'] = df_concat['stoptime'].astype(str)

# start station id, end station id, bikeid, birth year, gender: integer
for col in ['start station id', 'end station id', 'bikeid', 'birth year', 'gender']:
    df_concat[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_concat[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# start station name, end station name, usertype: string
for col in ['start station name', 'end station name', 'usertype']:
    df_concat[col] = df_concat[col].astype(str)

# start station latitude, start station longitude, end station latitude, end station longitude: float
for col in ['start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude']:
    df_concat[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_concat[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Final sanity check: remove any rows with missing critical data if needed (optional)
# Here we keep all rows as no instruction to drop rows.

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_concat.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
